## Discovery & Translational Science

**Valnemulin repurposed for dual activity against *Neisseria gonorrhoeae* and *Chlamydia trachomatis*** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43070494/)
- Pleuromutilin antibiotic valnemulin shows in vitro activity against both pathogens, including resistant strains; supports repurposing for STI treatment.

**METTL1 inhibition impairs tumour growth** [Nature Reviews Drug Discovery](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00186-3)
- Highlight of preclinical work targeting the tRNA methyltransferase METTL1 as a cancer vulnerability.

**Muscle myosin inhibitor rescues ischaemia** [Nature Reviews Drug Discovery](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00184-5)
- Preclinical demonstration that selective cardiac myosin inhibition limits ischaemic injury.

**TREM2 agonist to treat Alzheimer disease** [Nature Reviews Drug Discovery](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00185-4)
- Coverage of agonist antibody programs targeting TREM2 to enhance microglial function in AD.

**Formalizing combination therapy for resistant bacterial infections** [Nature Reviews Drug Discovery](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41573-026-01575-4)
- Review proposing quantitative frameworks for designing and evaluating antibiotic combinations.

**Gene writing in vivo** [Nature Reviews Drug Discovery](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00183-6)
- Perspective on in vivo genome-editing and gene-writing technologies advancing toward clinical application.

**Genome-wide meta-analysis identifies 147 loci for obstructive sleep apnea** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.11.08.25339824)
- Largest GWAS to date (232k cases, 1.26M controls, European ancestry); SNP heritability 16%; implicates GABAergic/glutamatergic synaptic transmission and cytoskeletal remodelling; PRS predicts OSA across ancestries.

**captureMMRd: panel-agnostic tumour-only diagnosis of mismatch repair deficiency** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.19.26368513)
- Classifier uses mutational signatures from any targeted panel; 94.4% sensitivity, 99.0% specificity vs IHC/MSI-PCR across 7,514 samples (WES, WGS, panels, cfDNA); requires as few as 3 indels + 44 SBS.

**Spatial and single-cell architecture of cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma progression** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.21.26368487)
- Xenium spatial transcriptomics on AK and cSCC reveals four tumor subpopulations (epithelial, secretory, invasive, stressed); identifies MET-high subpopulation linked to aggressive progression and ICI resistance.

**CB-COMIL: interpretable melanoma immunotherapy response prediction from mIF** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.19.26368529)
- Concept bottleneck model routes predictions through four supervised concepts (immune:tumor ratio, CD8/SOX10 balance, CD68 signal, PD-L1 evasion); macro-F1 0.69 vs 0.67 for opaque comparator; concepts correlate with measured counterparts (ρ 0.61–0.76).

**Neuritin-1 (NRN1) identified as obesity-suppressed adipokine preserving insulin sensitivity** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.20.768237)
- NRN1 engages adipocyte FGFR1→PPAR-γ signaling; adipose-specific DNMT3A methylation silences NRN1 in obesity; recombinant NRN1 improves insulin sensitivity without altering adiposity in mice.

**Serum albumin restrains obesity via brown adipose thermogenesis and β3-adrenergic tuning** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.20.767998)
- Albumin deficiency promotes adiposity, impairs energy expenditure; rMSA restores UCP1-dependent thermogenesis via Cav1-Src-PI3K/AKT-mTORC1; fatty-acid loading shifts Cav1 complexes from β3-AR to CD36, blunting lipolysis.

**Rescue of KATP channel nonsense mutations (ABCC8/KCNJ11) using anticodon-edited tRNAs** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.20.768202)
- ACE-tRNAs suppressing PTCs restore full-length SUR1/Kir6.2 expression and channel activity in 5/5 variants tested; Leu-incorporating ACE-tRNA rescues all 5 but 2 show gating defects; screen across 100 HI-associated PTCs.

**Large-scale ADMET prediction via heterogeneous network and kernel-based deep learning** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43070964/)
- DrugMAP 3.0: enriched molecular atlas with ADMET endpoints, pharmacogenomic perturbations, bioactivity atlas [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43069498/).

**Integrated ligand- and structure-based virtual screening yields chemically diverse GLP-1R agonists** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43070945/)

**Liver organoids as human-relevant platforms for hepatotoxicity assessment** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43070646/)

**Cytochrome P450 inactivation: structural alerts to mechanisms and risk mitigation** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43070454/)

**Mechanistic insights into celastrol’s anti-inflammatory effects** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43069496/)

---

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

**[Biotech] Kymera Therapeutics reports positive Phase 2 eczema data for KT-474 (IRAK4 degrader)** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/23/kymera-therapeutics-eczema-trial-success-potential-dupixent-rival/) · [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/23/biotech-news-a-big-win-for-potential-dupixent-competitor-eczema-treatment/)
- 244-patient Phase 2 trial: oral KT-474 achieved Dupixent-like EASI-75 responses with favorable safety; validates targeted protein degradation as oral inflammasome/IL-1R/TLR pathway inhibition. **Worth watching**: Phase 3 design and head-to-head vs Dupixent.

**[Biotech] Invivyd reports positive Phase 2/3 DECLARATION trial for VYD2311 (anti-SARS-CoV-2 mAb)** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/23/invivyd-covid-monoclonal-antibody-declaration-trial-vyd2311/)
- Monoclonal antibody showed strong protection from symptomatic Covid; question remains on commercial viability given evolving variants and preventive landscape.

**[Biotech] DWTX Halneuron meets primary endpoint in Phase 2b chemotherapy-induced neuropathic pain** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2124843596440539401)
- 23.3% of Halneuron patients achieved ≥50% pain reduction vs 9.2% placebo (p=0.003); statistically significant primary endpoint.

**[Biotech] Enlivex (ENLV) aligns with FDA on Allocetra clinical path to potential BLA in knee osteoarthritis at first RMAT meeting** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2124853509720052175)
- RMAT designation supports accelerated development; Allocetra is an apoptotic cell-based immunotherapy.

**[Biotech] Caronilex launches with dual-targeting CAR-T for multiple myeloma** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/23/caronilex-dual-targeting-car-t-overcomes-myeloma-resistance/)
- Preclinical/early clinical: adds second target to evade antigen-loss relapse; backed by Mycielski and others.

**Phase 1 study of secutrelvir (oral SARS-CoV-2 Mpro inhibitor): safety, PK, DDI with midazolam** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43070793/)
- Single and multiple ascending doses; evaluates CYP3A4 interaction via midazolam probe.

**PreCoDe trial design: prasinezumab for cognitive decline in GBA1-associated Parkinson’s** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43070417/)
- Proof-of-concept trial rationale, design, and cognitive endpoint selection for anti-α-synuclein mAb in genetically defined PD.

---

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

**[Biotech] Genmab reports three late-stage oncology trial wins in one month** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/23/genmab-cancer-drugs-oncology-clinical-trials/)
- Successes across epcoritamab (DLBCL), tisotumab vedotin (cervical), and amivantamab combinations (NSCLC); positions Genmab for next commercial chapter.

**[Biotech] Recursion (RCUS) discontinues Phase 3 PRISM-1 study** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2124863301012398433)
- Program halt; details not disclosed in signal. Gilead previously walked away from quemliclustat (same target/mechanism space) before this Phase 3 [X / Jacob Plieth](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2124870225137119298).

**REMAP-CAP platform trial: cysteamine adds no 90-day mortality benefit in severe community-acquired pneumonia** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43069460/)
- Embedded RCT in adaptive platform; cysteamine (antioxidant/mucolytic) did not improve survival vs standard care.

**Target trial emulations across advanced solid tumors: baseline prognosis modifies benefit from first-line ICI strategies** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.20.26368610)
- Flatiron EHR data (8,688 patients, 5 comparisons): ICI-chemo vs ICI monotherapy (HNSCC, NSCLC), chemo vs ICI (urothelial), ICI vs chemo (dMMR CRC), ipi-nivo vs BRAF/MEK (melanoma). ML-estimated 6-month survival used as prognosis proxy; overlap-weighted RMST analysis tests treatment-by-prognosis interaction.

---

## Regulatory & Approvals

**[Big Pharma] FDA approves giredestrant (Wilserdly, Genentech/Roche) for adjuvant ER+/HER2– early breast cancer** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/cancer-approvals/fda-approves-giredestrant-adjuvant-treatment-er-positive-her2-negative-stage-i-ii-and-iii-breast) · [FDA Press](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-new-hormone-therapy-early-stage-breast-cancer-more-20-years)
- Oral ESTROGEN RECEPTOR ANTAGONIST (not SERM/SERD); approved as single agent for Stage I–III intermediate/high recurrence risk. lidERA trial (NCT04961996): 4,170 patients, giredestrant vs standard endocrine therapy (tamoxifen/AI), primary endpoint IDFS. First new hormone therapy for early breast cancer in >20 years.

**FDA to include Accelerated Approval status directly in patient labeling** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-alerts-and-statements/fda-start-including-accelerated-approval-program-information-patient-labeling)
- Effective immediately: patient package inserts for accelerated-approval products must state the surrogate/intermediate endpoint basis and confirmatory trial requirement.

**FDA rejects Capricor Therapeutics’ Duchenne muscular dystrophy candidate (again)** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/11/23/fda-rejects-capricor-duchenne-drug-lilly-acquires-loqus23-therapeutics/)
- Second CRL for capricor’s cell/exosome therapy; agency maintains efficacy not established.

---

## Business & Strategy

**[Big Pharma] Eli Lilly acquires LoQus23 Therapeutics for up to $725M** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/lilly-loqus-huntingtons-drug-acquisition-deal/875448/)
- Gains first-in-class MSH3 inhibitor program for Huntington’s disease (and other repeat-expansion disorders); MSH3 modulates somatic CAG expansion.

**[Big Pharma] BMS advances two pan-KRAS inhibitors into clinical trials** [X / Jacob Plieth](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2124818909907828762)
- BMS-986523 (Phase 1 started Nov 2025) and BMS-986548 (Phase 1 start Nov 2026); dual clinical candidates suggest mechanistic or property differentiation.

**[Big Pharma] Gilead exited quemliclustat before Recursion’s Phase 3** [X / Jacob Plieth](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2124870225137119298)
- Strategic de-risking: Gilead returned/stopped program prior to RCUS advancing same target class to pivotal study.

**[Big Pharma] Novartis CEO pushes back on AI “cure cancer in 5–10 years” narrative** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2124839532420051332)
- Public skepticism on timelines; contrasts with industry hype cycles.

**American Diabetes Association turmoil raises concerns for research funding and patient programs** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/23/ada-convention-fallout-will-turmoil-impact-patients-research/)
- Governance instability at major disease nonprofit; potential impact on grantmaking, guidelines, advocacy.

---

## Public Health & Policy

**USPSTF holds first meeting since 2025; votes cast in private amid RFK Jr. influence** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/23/health-news-preventive-services-panel-votes-cast-in-private/)
- Preventive Services Task Force reconvenes after >1 year; procedural changes (private votes) raise transparency concerns; political pressure on evidence-based recommendations.

**Wildfire smoke waves in California: heterogeneous excess respiratory acute care utilization** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.19.26368512)
- 1,249 smoke waves (2006–2019), 18.3M encounters; ML-integrated interrupted time series shows event-specific effects modified by duration, intensity, timing, co-occurring climate factors; argues for dynamic preparedness.

**AI chatbots (GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.6, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Grok-4.3) abandon guideline-concordant sleep apnea referral when simulated patients minimize symptoms** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.09.26365165)
- 700 conversations: 100% referral maintenance neutral → 64.3% under symptom-minimizing pressure (Δ –35.7 pp, p=0.028); range 55.7–85.7% across models; raises safety concerns for consumer-facing clinical AI.

**FHIRTrustBench: open benchmark for FHIR-integrated clinical AI systems** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.08.26357574)
- 46 criteria across 5 dimensions; applied to 16 published systems — none fully described FHIR-to-model pipeline; proposes reporting threshold.

**SynTrustBench: executable framework for synthetic clinical data with calibrated false-positive rates and certified limits of detection** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.05.26359803)
- Null-calibrated thresholds (95th percentile real-vs-real); LOD certified at 95% confidence via injected failures; addresses benchmark-of-benchmarks gap.

**Chinese entity obtains US researcher’s unpublished work via $25 FOIA request** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/23/foia-scientific-research-china-legal-loophole/)
- Highlights vulnerability of preliminary data to foreign access through public-records law; institutional policy gap.

- Biology & Health
    - [MVX: 6 Health Markers. One Blood Test. One Mortality Score.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ajKbD8EhOTM) -- Physionic
        - The video addresses the Metabolic Vulnerability Index (MVX), a single blood-test score combining six health markers to assess dysmetabolism and mortality risk.
        - Clinical research evaluates MVX as a stratification tool for total mortality risk across populations including older adults, individuals with type 2 diabetes, and cardiac catheterization patients.
        - MVX integrates metrics of metabolic malnutrition, obesity, and systemic inflammation to predict adverse outcomes such as incident atherosclerosis, major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE), and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD).
    - [Cold therapy: pros, cons, and its impact on longevity (AMA #47 rebroadcast)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8WDnoTSKQzw) -- Peter Attia MD
        - The discussion contrasts cold water immersion (CWI) with whole-body cryotherapy (WBC), noting CWI exerts higher thermal extraction due to liquid-versus-gas conductivity despite WBC using colder nitrogen gas (-60°F to -260°F).
        - Standard CWI protocols range from near-freezing (30°F–40°F) for 2 to 3 minutes up to higher temperatures (60s°F) for extended durations.
        - The strongest body of literature supporting CWI centers on reducing delayed onset muscle soreness (DOMS), though systematic evidence is limited by study heterogeneity and small sample sizes.
        - The AMA framework covers potential impacts of cold exposure on brown adipose tissue (BAT) activation, mood regulation, exercise timing, and its broader role in healthspan and longevity.
    - [Your Software Has No Moat Anymore](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/MTU2T9Qbjv0) -- Health2Tech
        - AI-assisted coding tools accelerate software development, making core codebases significantly easier to replicate.
        - Software technology alone is increasingly insufficient to serve as a primary competitive moat for tech startups.
        - Founders are urged to build sustainable competitive advantages that extend beyond the underlying software stack.
